newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere mixed on decreased turnover.
newsitem.headline: Solidere mixed on decreased turnover.

text.p: Solidere shares were mixed on lower turnover on Friday on the Beirut Stock Exchange and dealers said the market was not affected by the formation of Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri's new government.
A shares were unchanged from Thursday's $115 and B shares fell slightly to $117.875 from $118.
Turnover in Solidere shares fell to 7,933 shares from Thursday's 14,098 and value was $926,012.5 from $1,629,459.375.
Dealers said the market was not affected by the formation of the new 30-member cabinet announced on Thursday evening.
"The market was not affected by the formation of the new cabinet because the key positions did not change. Hariri's people are still in charge in these positions," a dealer said.
There was no trade in the four other companies listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.02 percent to 84.72 and the BLOM stock index also fell 0.04 percent to 988.51.
